messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning a shadow-add for tenant_metadata tonight in the 02:00 UTC change window. approach = ADD COLUMN nullable + streaming per-tenant backfill.
kevin: good. how long do you expect the final swap to block? any quiesce needed?
maria: final swap will be a quick index swap — we expect a ~20-40s quiesce at most. main work is streaming backfill, non-blocking.
anjali: recommends per-worker row cap and replica-lag guard. propose 200r/s default, throttle to 50r/s if lag > 25s.
maria: agreed. adding a global probe and adaptive backoff in the runbook.
sam: deploybot will reserve the 01:50 UTC slot. paste the pin and rollback steps so I can add to release note.
maria: pin: `v3.7.1-schema-shadow-2026-03-21`
anjali: runbook excerpt:
```
# start backfill workers
./bin/backfill --table tenant_metadata --batch 500 --rate 200 --max-errors 5
# monitor replica lag
curl -fsS https://infra-metrics/replica_lag | jq .lag_seconds
```

maria: deploybot: request a post-schema-apply holdpoint at canary for 10m.
deploybot: holdpoint set 02:05:00 UTC for thread 1746667777. canary rule -> 5%.
ci-bot: nightly-integration: build 2148 for v3.7.1-schema-shadow passed :white_check_mark:
kevin: rollback plan please.
maria: rollback plan: stop workers, flip feature flag off. column is nullable so leaving it in DB is safe. if we need to revert reads, run `pg:swap-views` and re-pin binary to `v3.7.0`.
anjali: add alerts: replica_lag > 60s, canary error-rate > 5%.
sam: added alerts and release note: "tenant_metadata shadow add + streaming backfill; 5% canary -> 25% -> 100%; rate-limited workers with lag guard." runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/shadow-backfill
kevin: ensure ADD COLUMN is add-null (instant). final index will be created CONCURRENTLY. if we observe table-level locks, consider `pg_repack` after maintenance.
maria: confirmed.
anjali: we'll watch in #eng-oncall during the window.
maria: no objections to 02:00 start -> proceeding.
kevin: ack.
deploybot: canary started at 02:05 UTC (5% traffic). monitoring hooks active.
ci-bot: smoke checks ok. latency within baseline.
maria: backfill workers ramping to 200/s across 4 workers.
anjali: seeing replica lag ~10s.
kevin: on lag >25s throttle to 50/s immediately.
maria: throttle applied -> 50/s.
deploybot: canary holdpoint cleared. rolling to 25% now.
sam: rolling wave 2 -> 25%.
maria: final index CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY scheduled in wave 3; will swap views after index ready.
kevin: if swap fails, abort rollout and keep column nullable; ops will follow rollback steps.
ci-bot: final smoke after index create: ok.
maria: index created CONCURRENTLY and view swap done at 03:12:05 UTC. no errors.
deploybot: rollout complete. pinned release v3.7.1-schema-shadow-2026-03-21. tagging @eng-sre for post-deploy review.
maria: runbook attached to release note. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
